mathematical_contract: finite time-expanded shared-capacity multicommodity linear flow; relax shared arc capacities only
holdout: Boston_10OD; never inspect its R2 result before selection and policy freeze

common.subgradient: g[a] = usage[a] - capacity[a] on the full dynamic graph
common.projected_direction_norm: q[a] = g[a] if lambda[a] > 0 or g[a] > 0; otherwise 0. Use ||q|| in every step denominator; the projected update still uses full g.
common.paths: one commodity-specific DAG shortest path under cost+lambda per iteration; add unique complete paths in lexicographic arc-ID tie order; cap 100 paths per commodity
common.primal_recovery: independent restricted path LP with original costs, demand equalities, shared capacities and nonnegative path flows at iteration 1, each multiple of 10, and the final iteration; record infeasibility separately
common.stop: stop at 1% certified duality gap after independent feasible primal, or at iteration/wall budget; no reference objective used
common.gap: max(0,(independent feasible primal objective - independently recomputed best dual)/max(1,abs(primal objective)))
common.tie_breaking: stable input arc-ID lexicographic order; first shortest predecessor on ties within 1e-10; duplicate path identified by exact arc-ID sequence

variants.rule: Polyak using independently recovered feasible upper bound; normalized fallback before an upper bound exists
variants.step_coefficient: if U finite and U>D: min(0.7*(U-D)/max(||q||_2^2,1), 15/max(||q||_2,1)); else 5/(sqrt(t)*max(||q||_2,1))

variants.rule: Polyak using independently recovered feasible upper bound; normalized fallback before an upper bound exists
variants.step_coefficient: if U finite and U>D: min(1.5*(U-D)/max(||q||_2^2,1), 15/max(||q||_2,1)); else 5/(sqrt(t)*max(||q||_2,1))

selection_rule: Among variants independently passing all development gates, choose smallest Sioux_250OD certified gap; ties within 1e-9 choose lower Sioux_250OD wall time, then lexicographically smallest variant ID. Sioux_200OD must remain feasible, match the reference objective in final evaluation, and have gap <= R1 gap + 0.0001. If none passes, select none, report SIOUX_250_GATE_NOT_MET, and do not run Boston.
reference_policy: No reference primal/dual/path/flow or objective in algorithm, pool, step, recovery, or stopping. Separate final evaluator may read objective only after run artifacts close.
